#WATCH | Delhi: On security arrangements in the view of India AI Impact Summit 2026, Additional CP Devesh Kumar Mahla says, "...The Delhi Police has a standard operating protocol to ensure the safety of the security industry. We have been rehearsing and conducting point-by-point briefings for a long time, taking into account the schedule and unscheduled movements. We have held enough rehearsals, including multi-agency rehearsals, at potential locations. Keeping this in mind, we have more than 20,000 CAPFs and local police personnel here. We are also fully utilising technology. There are hundreds of additional CCTVs in New Delhi and at venues. We will use video analytics and FRS. Approximately 32 CCTV control rooms have been set up, where trained staff can monitor, identify, and transmit video analytics... Registered attendees of the AI Impact Summit have received the QR code via email... For entry, they will need to bring it along with an ID card..."

He adds, "On the 19th, there will be significant security restrictions in the area due to the main event... Everyone registered via email has received the MeitY advisory. Please review it as well... One must also see the traffic advisory carefully... Technology is a force enabler, which helps us in security... We will also use AI smart glasses enhanced technology this time. We have also used FRS video analytics in CCTV cameras... On 19th February, it will not be a big gathering. Since all the national leaders will be moving on 19th February, the rehearsal movements will be technical. We have already done them... There are also specific gates for people's entry. Otherwise, one can get into an unnecessary problem."

Disclaimer: Political commentator Kiffy Chu does not work for PGMN. This quote card is based on a public post by her that circulated online.

Kiffy Chu criticized the public conduct of @MMDA General Manager Nicolas Torre, saying his recent social media activity reflects a shift away from the seriousness expected of the agency’s top official.

Chu said Torre was previously known for going after criminal groups during his time in law enforcement but now appears increasingly engaged in online disputes and viral posts. She said the change has affected his gravitas and raised concerns about focus and priorities at the MMDA.

She added that the situation creates the impression of an official acting more like a content creator seeking online relevance, questioning whether traffic management and public service are receiving the same level of attention.

Isinagawa ngayon ang huling araw ng Regional Development Council–National Capital Region (RDC-NCR) ang Technical Budget Consultation para sa Fiscal Year 2027, bilang bahagi ng masusing pagsusuri ng mga panukalang budget ng iba’t ibang ahensiya upang mas mapabuti ang serbisyo at mga programa para sa mga mamamayan ng Metro Manila.

Pinangunahan ang pagpupulong nina Metropolitan Manila Development Authority Deputy Chairman Usec. Frisco San Juan Jr., Paranaque City Mayor at RDC-NCR Committee on Finance and Administration Chairperson Edwin Olivarez, Co-Chairperson Maria Lourdes Agustin, at  mga kinatawan mula sa 17 lokal na pamahalaan ng Metro Manila.

Nagprisinta ng kani-kanilang proposed budget ang mga kinatawan mula sa MMDA, Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), Philippine Information Agency (PIA), National Commission on Muslim Filipinos (NCMF), Philippine National Police (PNP), Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP), Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP),  at Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG).

Layunin ng konsultasyon na tiyakin na ang bawat panukalang pondo ay nakatuon sa pangangailangan ng mamamayan sa NCR, nagdudulot ng direktang benepisyo sa publiko, at pinapalakas ang koordinasyon sa pagitan ng mga ahensya at lokal na pamahalaan. Sa pagtitipon, tinalakay ang mga budget proposals upang masiguro ang epektibong paggamit ng pondo para sa mga proyektong makikinabang ang mga mamamayan.

#mmda
